inheritance.law: This extends, does not replace, prior UberBond/APEX/Jev/Frontier Quality Compression/Sovereign Cognitive Continuum canon. Omission is not deletion.

founderIntent.objective: Continuously obtain the highest verified intelligence commercially available in the market at the lowest achievable total cost, without reducing quality.
founderIntent.analogy: grades up while study time down -> verified intelligence quality up while cost and founder effort down
founderIntent.keyDistinction: Do not optimize for the smartest system personally affordable. First identify the strongest available market intelligence, then minimize the cost of reproducing or exceeding its finished-work quality.

objective.preferredMetric: verified frontier-quality useful work per dollar
secondaryMetrics: frontier calls avoided by certified Jev circuits per Jev dollar
reference frontier cost avoided divided by actual UberMind spend
verified useful work per founder minute

prohibited: lower reasoning setting without zero-loss proof

physicalArchitecture.directProviderApis: optional donors when materially better on price/features/exact controls
physicalArchitecture.doctrine: Hardware is rented. Models are replaceable suppliers. Price is attacked through orchestration.

pr1027Reconciliation.clarification: Founder later clarified TypingMind remains the interactive UI rather than a custom UberBond chat frontend.
pr1027Reconciliation.retainedValue: PR #1027 OpenRouter executor remains a backend/donor/unattended-worker capability for night shift, tournaments, or automation when TypingMind is closed.
pr1027Reconciliation.supersedes: Any implication that UberBond must build a new interactive chat UI.

frontierCrown.definition: strongest verified current model or task-specific frontier model
succession: if it beats incumbent under required evidence, promote Crown/Pantheon role
revalidate important Jev circuits against new Crown
frontierCrown.rule: Frontier improvement automatically raises UberMind's quality floor.

crownFinalizerLaw: treat other models as evidence, attacks, counterexamples, alternate frames, and minority hypotheses
change baseline only when independently justified
retain baseline if swarm adds no verified improvement
practicalSequence.adaptiveN: 2 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16 -> specialist -> second Crown only around real uncertainty

jevHyperreflex.coreFlywheel: Crown discovers -> semantic decomposition -> Jev typed reflexes -> repeated stability -> deterministic code
jevHyperreflex.decisionBundling: Prefer one shared state with many typed decisions rather than repeated state ingestion.
jevHyperreflex.decompositionLaw: Exact problem -> code; bounded fuzzy semantic judgment -> Jev; novel generative search -> cheap swarm; irreducible novel reasoning -> Crown.
jevHyperreflex.confidenceLaw: Jev confidence is routing evidence, never proof.

mandatoryPostCrownQuestions: under what conditions are they valid?
can fuzzy parts become typed Jev circuits?
can exact parts become deterministic code?
what drift signal should decompile the circuit?
crownToJevToCode.goal: Every expensive Crown call should solve the present task and create reusable cognitive capital when safe.
crownToJevToCode.law: Crown thinks once -> Jev decides cheaply many times -> code eventually executes near-zero marginal cost.

promotionRequires: zero observed paired regressions under canonical gate
jevCertification.continuousAudit: Sample certified Jev circuits against current Crown forever. Crown succession reopens important circuits to shadow.

jevAdaptiveCompute.principle: Jev decides where cheap computation expands and may freely trigger more review.
jevAdaptiveCompute.example: 2 workers -> Jev tests material disagreement/new information value -> stop or expand -> repeat -> Crown when unresolved
jevAdaptiveCompute.authorityBoundary: Jev may suppress required Crown review only inside explicitly zero-loss-certified routing domains.

outputRouting.expensive: material unresolved claims -> Adversarial Synthesis -> Crown

jevClaimFirewall.purpose: Semantic garbage collection so Crown sees signal instead of transcript sludge.

adversarialSynthesis.output: dispute dossier of exact unresolved atoms, not a vote

frontierDelta.principle: The most expensive model receives only information necessary to decide.
frontierDelta.compressionLaw: A token cheaper than a cached token is a token never sent.

caching.exact: authoritative reuse candidate only when request identity and relevant source-state identity match
caching.semantic: suggestion/prefetch/shadow only unless separately zero-loss certified
caching.law: Semantic similarity is not logical equivalence.

alwaysOn24x7.meaning: UberMind is continuously alive, monitoring, queuing, preparing, retrieving, testing, crystallizing, and waking expensive cognition when justified.
alwaysOn24x7.architecture: Persistent logical agents behave like OS processes. Inference streams wake only when queues/events/uncertainty justify them.

interactiveVsNightShift.interactive: TypingMind on iPad for normal chat, model switching, multi-model comparison, prompts/agents, and final Crown interaction.
interactiveVsNightShift.unattended: Existing UberBond cloud worker may run queues, research, retrieval, cheap exploration, Jev circuits, tests, artifact preparation, dispute packets, and authorized deferred/Batch frontier jobs while TypingMind is closed.

monthlyBudget.currentEconomicGame: never buy less intelligence; buy less computation to obtain it

jawDroppingCompressionGoal.aspiration: Make about $30/month behave like vastly more expensive frontier usage, potentially thousands-of-dollars-class reference compute/work value.
jawDroppingCompressionGoal.referenceCostEquivalent: Cost of strongest verified baseline performing matched work directly.
jawDroppingCompressionGoal.compressionFactor: Reference Cost Equivalent / actual UberMind all-in cost.
jawDroppingCompressionGoal.promotionGate: Matched task quality must satisfy UberMind >= reference frontier. Cheap-but-worse does not count.

budgetStrategy: spend almost nothing when nothing useful is happening
prefer exact code/retrieval/cache before semantic inference
use Jev for abundant bounded microdecisions
send lossless dispute delta to Crown
compile recurring cognition downward to Jev/code
scoreboard: Crown calls avoided by certified reflexes

qualityComparison.baseline: Strongest verified market Crown solves task directly.
qualityComparison.candidate: UberMind with cloud market, cheap heterogeneous workers, tools/retrieval/code, Jev control, adversarial synthesis, sparse Crown adjudication.
qualityComparison.preferredEvaluation: blinded paired evaluation on important new task classes
qualityComparison.failure: UberMind worse on any required dimension

implemented: TypingMind cockpit decision preserved by this canon
notYetProven: current Crown for every task class
production Jev calibration across UberMind workloads

minimalActivationResources: current Crown + cheap worker + Jev model access through OpenRouter where available
existing UberBond cloud/backend only when unattended night-shift work is needed
optionalLaterResources: direct Anthropic key if native Batch/cache/control economics materially win
direct OpenAI key if native Flex/Batch/cache/control economics materially win
direct TypeSafe/Jev key if direct Jev economics/features materially win
other direct providers only after measured advantage
activationSequence: import current Crown, cheap workers, and Jev
turn on unattended cloud night shift only when interactive path is verified

recovery.instruction: Do not restart architecture design in a new chat. Recover this canon and continue from activation/empirical proof.
order: recover Total Brain / Master Memory / Current Handoff
read absolute frontier quality lock and current model registry
continue from activation and empirical proof
never: restart from which models should we use
reduce UberMind to Opus plus cheap agents
assume any current model is permanently best
replace TypingMind with custom interactive UI without founder instruction
claim thousands-of-dollars equivalent without matched live evidence

nextFrontier: PLUG_IN -> COLLECT_LIVE_RECEIPTS -> RUN_PAIRED_CROWN_VS_UBERMIND_TRIALS -> CALIBRATE_JEV -> CERTIFY_BOUNDED_REFLEXES -> MEASURE_COMPRESSION_FACTOR -> MUTATE_ARCHITECTURE_FROM_EVIDENCE
finalInvariant: Highest verified intelligence available in the market at the lowest achievable all-in price. Crown thinks once, Jev decides cheaply many times, code eventually executes near-zero marginal cost; anything new, uncertain, drifted, or outside certification returns to the Crown.
